From the owner
This client's lovely home is nestled between the Arizona Canal and Camelback Mountain in the historic neighborhood of Arcadia. We updated their primary bathroom in the transitional style, complete with a double vanity, free-standing soaking tub, and a spacious walk-in shower. We focused on warm tones and natural materials to create a welcoming environment, while contrasting with dark tile floors and distinct patterns to keep the space feeling contemporary. The result is the perfect balance of comfort and polish to guarantee a timeless remodel.
Sep 30, 2026
